b: Streaks of sunlight pierced the clouds and fell on the sand. Deftly escaping them, he drew his fingers back into the shade. From the shade, he enjoyed the light
He escaped the sunlight, but not the waves. The sea wet his feet and went away.
The sky seemed to be laughing at him. Was it only the sea he had failed to escape?
A slap on his back.
He turned round. Behind him, she was laughing. It was her. Her and no one else
"Is this how you sit staring at the sea, without even knowing who's coming……...I told you to come at five, didn't I ...why are you so early ..there's still half an hour…."
"Well…."

In that violet salwar she gave the sky itself a new colour. As usual she had left her hair open, untied. Only one or two strands flew about, unable to bear the strength of the wind; tidying them with her hands, she came and sat beside him..those eyes……….
"What, da, sitting there gaping without saying anything ..anyway, you've come ..come and help me arrange all this here ...Magizh will be here in 10 minutes, he says"
Only ten minutes? Couldn't he come a bit later? ..Is this what I came so early for!
"What, da!! First put this in the box"
Only then did he come back to the waking world. "Wait! Wait! Don't give me all the jobs at once!! ..We can do it at leisure!"
"If you do it at a tortoise's pace, we'll only finish everything after he's come"
Her phone suddenly rang. She walked away as she talked.

Her footprints in that wet sand ..she walked so gently, as if ants were stepping on a chrysanthemum. Even so, as if it had been waiting just for her, the sand tried to draw her into itself. But she had already lifted her feet ...The sea consoled the ground, which bore the wounds of disappointment, with its waves
She finished talking and came back, somehow disappointed.
"What happened?"
"That was Magizh. He says it'll take a bit longer to come. He says to wait. OK, come, let's get on with the work"
"Mmmm" …..Phew, a little more time.
"Talk about something …., it'll pass the time for me too"
"Talk about what!!".......There are a thousand things to say..can I say them all!
"Say something ..hey, when did you go this silent?????? ..Earlier you'd fight with me non-stop!! What happened now??"
He smiled without saying anything...It's all because of you.
"Do you remember our first meeting??"
"Mmm, I remember a little bit"..... He hadn't forgotten.
"You won't remember a thing ..the college group project ..remember now at least?"
"Aaah ...I remember!"
"So many years ago ..even now when I think of it, it's fun"
"Of course it was fun for you..you were the one nagging us all to do the work .."
"Who, me! Me!..That was Meena ..I never gave you lot that much trouble"
"Yeah, right ..have you forgotten the time we didn't do the work and you walked off in a huff!" he asked, laughing.
"Yes, no!!" she said, running her fingers through her hair...beautiful.
"Yes? Or no?"
They both laughed
"Back then I used to get really angry. I walked off in a huff once ..and you were the one who came after me and consoled me!"
"…...mmmm"
"What ...mmm...have you forgotten?"
"No, I remember!"....How could I forget
"Yes, with all the others doing nothing, why did only you come looking for me…"
"I felt like it, so I came".
"Why did only you feel like that?"
"Don't know"....Don't you know..stop acting!
She laughed
"No idea when this Magizh will come...come, let's just walk a bit in the breeze"
"You walk in front; I'll come behind"
"OK"
She in front
he behind
"Why, da, come talking about something, will you!"
"Should I walk now? Or talk?"
"Ah ...sing a song..walk and talk, you nut .." she frowned…..pretend anger
"Talk about what!"
"Talk about something I like!"
………You like the rain, you like the sea ..you like Vaali's lyrics, you like Vidyasagar's music, you like Tamil, you like sleeping with a pillow, you like chocolate, you like Balachander's films ……
"How would I know what you like?"
"What's the use of being friends all these years,,,you don't even know this"
"Then tell me what I like, let's see?"
"Wait! Wait! I'll give you three chances ..let's see you get it right. You have to say the one thing I like most
"Mmmm, if you just ask like that, what do I say ..you like lots of things ..if you ask which one most, how can I say
"Find out.."
"OK wait ..mmmm ..you like singing!"
"Mmm...I do like it….there's something more than that"
"Cricket?"
"Mmm...more than that"
"Something else …………………………. You like writing poems..correct?"
"Correct," he said, and laughed
"See ..!" She was proud, as if she had achieved something.
"Even in writing poems, there's one thing I like most"
"What's that?" she asked, walking on ahead.
He didn't walk.
"I like writing poems about you"
And she stopped too.
note: Vaali was a celebrated Tamil film lyricist, Vidyasagar a film composer, and K. Balachander a film director. "Da" is an informal, affectionate way of addressing a male friend.
